expectation: Membrane-ring stain on dendritic cells and some macrophages, a minority of cells, scattered or clustered in immune-rich stroma and aggregates, overlapping with HLADR-positive cells.
observed: A: yellow signal varies by ROI, with dense patches in immune-rich areas and sparse signal elsewhere. B/C: sparse, elongated or irregular cells. D: crisp membrane rings on neighbouring cells. E: CD11c lies in a subset of HLADR-rich cells, partly white and partly green.
why: CD11c shows a specific membrane-localised subset of cells that clusters in immune-rich regions and sits within HLADR-positive cells, as expected.
